t: What Gene Function Evidence Database Is All About
title: What Gene Function Evidence Database Is All About
description: A gene's function is what it actually does, proven by experiment: knock it out and watch what breaks. The lac operon's lacZ makes beta-galactosidase (digests lactose); BRCA1 repairs DNA (mutations raise breast cancer risk); CFTR moves chloride (mutations cause cystic fibrosis). Evidence grades matter: a knockout phenotype beats a sequence guess every time. This database is the complete gene-function link: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Gene Function Evidence Database: a complete reference database of full gene-function link records.

t: Core Vocabulary of Gene Function Evidence Database
title: Core Vocabulary of Gene Function Evidence Database
description: Every field has its own language. These are the working terms of Gene Function Evidence Database — learn them first and every later record reads faster: knockout: deleting a gene to observe the effect; phenotype: observable result of a genotype; operon: clustered genes under one control switch; transcription factor: protein switching genes on/off.
definition: The working vocabulary of Gene Function Evidence Database: the terms practitioners actually use.
key_points: knockout: deleting a gene to observe the effect
phenotype: observable result of a genotype
operon: clustered genes under one control switch
transcription factor: protein switching genes on/off
allele: a version of a gene
loss-of-function: mutation breaking the gene's job
